name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It reviews Europe's Beating Cancer Plan, launched in 2021, and says it has done real work but has not been measured by whether patients actually live longer. It asks the European Commission to keep funding cancer work after 2028, to finally update the rules on tobacco and alcohol labels, to set clear targets for screening, and to report every year to Parliament on results.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of requests to the Commission and Member States, with no legal force.
- **Who it affects:** Cancer patients, smokers and young people, drinkers, researchers, and national health systems.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on the requests; Parliament wants yearly progress reports.
